name: Myanmar
value: Junta claims resistance HQ near Mon–Bago line
summary: Junta says it took a resistance command and 10 bases on the Mon–Bago border; no major city has changed hands
state: State media said on 10 Nov that the army seized a NUG special region command and 10 other bases along the Mon state–Bago region border after a six-day operation; the claim could not be independently verified (The Star, 11 Nov). Local media reported that military airstrikes on 1–2 Nov killed at least 15 civilians across townships in Rakhine and Karenni states (UNI India). Searches on 15 Nov found no major city changing hands and no cross-border escalation, so the signal stays at Watch.
for_you: No direct risk to UK residents. The FCDO advises against travel to much of Myanmar; anyone with links there can follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen or cross-border escalation

sources.title: The Star — Military seizes key resistance headquarters in six-day blitz
UNI India — Myanmar airstrikes kill at least 15 civilians

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
